name: 简报模式
author: Yggdrasil
description: 示例插件：**改 Agent 的核心行为**（往系统提示里插一段"输出从简"）并**给界面加一个页面**（工具栏按钮 + 常驻窗口）。

prompts.label: 输出从简
prompts.text:
## Keep it short
Keep the "reasoning" field to **one short sentence (at most ~20 words)** and never restate the user request.
The user reads the ops, not your prose — a long reasoning pushes the thing they asked about out of view.
